headline: Q2FY27 Result Review

highlights: Revenue, EBITDA and PAT grew by 43%, 72% and 67% for the quarter on YoY basis.
The revenue growth was majorly led by strong growth in the exports of auto components which grew by 90% YoY to Rs 1.29bn.

The domestic bearings segment and the domestic auto components segment registered healthy growth of ~10% and ~30% respectively on YoY basis.  Strong Demand Outlook for Auto Components: The management expects strong growth in the auto components segment with strong volume recovery from US customers with the receding of tariff issues.

Most of the programs in this segment are expected to ramp up well with peak revenue expected in FY28 and FY29.We estimate Auto Components to clock in healthy export led revenue growth in FY27 post a tariff disrupted FY26.  Demand Outlook for Bearing Rings: The bearing rings segment is expected to exhibit steady growth with healthy growth from the automotive side.
valuation: The management expects Rs 150 mn of duty refund from customers in Q3 and Q4FY27 as well.  Valuation and Outlook: With the settling down of the tariff uncertainty and improved demand outlook in both the business verticals, we expect Rolex to be a strong beneficiary of the “Manufacture in India” theme.

Capex Plans  Budgeted Annual Capex: Maintained within the planned Rs300–Rs400Mn per year range.  Capacity Utilization: Currently operating at 65% utilization, targeting 70–72% by FY27-end using existing fungible forging and machining infrastructure.  Green Energy Expansion: Adding a 9 MW solar plant by Mid-CY2026 to reach 60% renewable energy consumption by 2030.
